cues.text: On the longest night of the year, the mountain goes to sleep early.
In Artenara, one bar was still open, and one woman was still awake.
She had found something in the cave that week. Something that should not have been missing.
She told one person. Then she started down the mountain.
From the summit, the road falls a thousand metres into the cloud.
She had driven it a hundred times.
Behind her, the lights of the camp went out, one by one.
Seven marks on a cave wall. She had counted six.
Then the cloud closed over the road, and the air began to smell of salt.
She had time to leave one thing behind.
In the morning, they found her car at the bottom of a dry ravine. The windows were closed.
She had drowned. It had not rained on that side of the mountain for forty days.
